_comment: ADR-014: images are cosign-signed in CI and clients enforce the signature.
This is the client half — without it the signing is theatre, because nothing
PRD WP-04 specifies usr/etc/containers/policy.json. It cannot live there:
`bootc container lint` rejects /usr/etc outright, which WP-01 already hit and
recorded. /etc is the shipped location and bootc treats it as the machine's
own, so this file is also the one an offline-ISO install path must be able to
The default is insecureAcceptAnything rather than reject: this ships BEFORE
the key exists, and a policy that rejects everything makes an unbootable
machine, not a secure one. The scoped rule below is the real gate, and the
default tightens once WP-04's signing is live and proven by the negative
test (an unsigned image MUST be refused).
